description: This file contains unit tests for the UserRoleManagerHelper class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing permissions and self-identification related to user roles and employees.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the UserRoleManagerHelper providing tests for permission retrieval and user self-identification.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithoutAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee without an assigned Employee object.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee with an associated Employee object.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when the user is acting on their own data.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForNotSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when the user is acting on another employee's data.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a collection of data group permissions for an employee.

methods.name: testIsSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Parameterized test checking if the user ID matches the given employee number.
